tasks.short: Develop, analyse and test meals for special dietary requirements.

steps.what: Confirm dietary requirements and exclusions
Develop ingredients, portions and preparation instructions
Calculate nutrient quantities and compare with explicit meal criteria
Prepare the trial meal and evaluate its practical suitability
Record trial results and final recipe adjustments
Approve the final recipe and recalculated dietary checks
Commit the accepted recipe to the controlled kitchen recipe library

tasks.design: Test native recipe and nutrient calculation features in the food-service system in {OTHER} before extending the workbook in {SPREADSHEET}. Calculate from weighed recipe quantities and verified ingredient data; the dietitian retains recipe development, cooking tests and final clinical checks before a separate controlled recipe release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ingredient quantities and supplier specifications are often maintained separately from recipe documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing recipe software can apply fixed nutrient arithmetic and version-controlled release.
tasks.still_hard: Taste, preparation constraints, allergens and clinical suitability require professional checks.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an impractical or clinically inappropriate meal despite acceptable calculated totals.

ambition.what: Recheck the nutrient impact of each tested ingredient substitution before recipe acceptance.

tasks.altitude: Less nutrient arithmetic and recipe-library entry; trial cooking and dietary decisions retain their time.

reach.learn: Nutrient units, preparation yield and supplier specification versions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: nutrient totals are deterministic when ingredient quantities, nutrient densities and yields are available.

assumptions: Boundary covers a dietitian personally developing and testing a special meal, not routine kitchen production or patient consultation. Shares are provisional and require observation.

s1 produces restriction_code, nutrient_limit, units and meal_basis; vague requests such as chemical-free require clarification rather than literal automatic acceptance. s2 records ingredient_id, grams, preparation_yield and portions.

Ingredient specifications contain nutrient_per_100g, allergen_status, source_version and validity_date. Purchasing maintains supplier specifications; dietitian verifies uncertain values manually in s2. Missing data block calculated approval, never become zeros.
Native calculation runs again on the final s5 recipe during s6; this runtime earns no separate labour saving. s6 checks values, yields, exclusions and practical trial findings before approving a1.

s5 note capture and final adjustments remain fully human. Existing manual calculation and recipe-library entry must be observed; if already automatic, remove that saving. Changes to ingredients, specifications or destinations revoke approval.
unknowns: Recipe software and current manual arithmetic
research_questions: Does the recipe system preserve cooked yield and unit correctness across substitutions?

already_counted.description: Check calculated meal values against ingredient evidence in s6

incremental.description: Check nutrient mappings and release controls after recipe-system updates

approvals.approved_version: s6 accepted final recipe version plus ingredient specification snapshot and kitchen-library destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional: 15 drafting points minus one upkeep = 14; half the drafting benefit gives 6.5. Saving the entry earns no reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise food-service managers on safe, affordable nutrition programmes.

steps.what: Review facility records, menus and operating constraints
Identify priorities and develop feasible recommendations
Discuss recommendations and trade-offs with the food-service manager
Write the advice note and action responsibilities

loop.input: Dietitian's captured decisions, exact source extracts and unresolved questions
loop.output: Advice note linking each recommendation to evidence and distinguishing agreed actions from unresolved choices
loop.check: Dietitian checks recommendation meaning, feasibility, owner commitments and source support within s4; s5 reviews the final version for release
loop.stop: One draft and one revision, then manual writing; no unsupported sanitation rule or budget invented
loop.why_not_simpler: First test a fixed advice form. Free-text trade-offs still need explanatory prose; fixed fields alone cannot preserve qualifications and unresolved disagreements.

steps.what: Approve the final advice note and recipient
Send the accepted advice note to the manager

tasks.design: Keep evidence review and managerial discussion human, and first test an advice template in {DOCS}. A bounded drafting step can express the dietitian's captured recommendations and caveats; {EMAIL} sends only the completed note approved by the dietitian to the named internal manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice note must preserve context, practical constraints and disagreement.
tasks.enabler_now: Grounded text drafting can reduce rewriting without selecting the advice.
tasks.still_hard: Facility-specific safety gaps and budget trade-offs remain professional decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge a manager's unsafe compromise and explain an achievable alternative.

ambition.what: Provide a written action note that separates agreed fixes from questions awaiting evidence.

tasks.altitude: Less post-meeting rewriting; decision rights over programme expenditure do not change.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a bounded model can draft prose from a professional's recommendations, but food-service advice still requires substantive human review.

assumptions: Boundary is the dietitian's advisory work, including its written follow-up and send. Manager attendance and implementation are separate unchanged work, with no transferred drafting burden or saving claimed.

Shares are provisional. s3 retains capture of recommendation_text, owner, deadline, caveat and unresolved_question at full effort. s1 obtains menu_version, food-safety observations, source_date and cost_period from facility records; absent evidence is gathered manually within retained work.

Food-safety guidance is maintained by the organisation's quality lead with title, paragraph, version and review_date. No model creates a regulatory obligation; unsupported recommendations stay unresolved.

s5 checks the final revised note, complete audience and confidentiality. Its exact message snapshot gates s6; any revision or recipient change revokes a1. The manager is internal, so sending has write_internal authority.
Native templates and draft assistance must be tested before code; if notes are already concise structured action lists, do not assume this drafting benefit.
unknowns: Whether advice recipients are internal or external
research_questions: Can reviewers identify every changed commitment or unsupported safety recommendation before release?

already_counted.description: Read and correct generated note meaning in s4
Final send content and audience check within s5

incremental.description: Review drafting failures and maintain advice headings

approvals.approved_version: s5 accepted complete advice note and named internal recipient snapshot

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional: six drafting points minus one upkeep = five; half the drafting benefit gives two. Delivery remains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and administer food, equipment and supplies budgets.

steps.what: Collect spending, commitments and service-volume figures
Set demand, replacement and price assumptions
Calculate food, equipment and supply budget lines
Review the final budget and approve within delegated limits
Commit the accepted budget to the finance system
Compare actual spending and commitments with the active budget
Investigate variances and decide spending adjustments

tasks.design: Test native budgets and commitment reports in {ERP}, using a controlled {SPREADSHEET} model only for gaps. Apply explicit quantity, price and period rules to create a budget and variance view; the dietitian retains demand assumptions, final approval and decisions about corrective action before separate gated budget posting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Budget scenarios and commitments may sit outside the same finance view.
tasks.enabler_now: Native budgeting, controlled formulas and validated imports can handle repeated arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Forecast uncertainty and trade-offs between service quality and spending remain.
tasks.human_edge: Decide which cost pressure can be absorbed without reducing safe nutrition provision.

ambition.what: Review food-cost variance including open commitments at each monthly budget meeting.

tasks.altitude: Less calculation and posting; more time to explain emerging cost pressures. Delegated spending limits stay unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare a reconciled meal-cost variance table
reach.learn: Cost centres, commitments and quantity-price variance

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: budget multiplication, aggregation and actual-versus-budget comparisons are deterministic; forecast assumptions are judgement.

assumptions: Boundary ends at corrective spending decisions. Purchase orders, payments and revised-budget posting each require their own downstream approval, and no savings from those are included. Shares are provisional manual-work allocations.

Finance produces expense fields cost_centre, account, period, amount and currency; purchasing produces commitment_id, outstanding_amount and delivery_period; meal counts contain period and quantity from food service. s1 retains all collection and missing-field repair effort.

s2 produces item_category, quantity, unit_price, replacement_date, period and scenario_version. Equipment condition comes from facilities' existing inspection records; supplier prices are dated source schedules. Missing prices or volumes are entered manually during s2, not guessed.
Test native calculation/reporting first. Only currently manual arithmetic, comparison and posting earn savings; existing scheduled system execution earns none.

s4 includes complete-content and authority-limit review after calculation. Above-limit cases stay with existing finance escalation and do not auto-post; the central case is within the dietitian's delegated limit. Edits invalidate a1.
unknowns: Existing finance automation and account mapping
research_questions: Do import totals reconcile to the ledger and do open commitments avoid double counting invoiced amounts?

already_counted.description: Reconcile draft budget totals to source figures in s4

incremental.description: Maintain quantity-price assumptions and investigate broken mappings beyond ordinary variance review
Maintain finance import permissions and account mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 accepted complete budget version, cost centre, period and finance destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional: 30 budget preparation points minus 1.5 upkeep = 28.5; half benefit gives 13.5. The commit earns no reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan, conduct and evaluate research linking nutrition and genetic variation.

steps.what: Develop the research question, protocol and analysis plan
Review the final protocol and participant safeguards
Conduct the approved study and record research observations
Calculate protocol-specified quality checks and statistical results
Evaluate data quality, uncertainty and biological interpretation
Write and check the research report and reproducibility package
Commit the checked research package to the restricted study archive

tasks.design: Keep protocol design, study conduct and interpretation human. After testing native research-tool pipelines in {OTHER}, execute only the approved analysis specification on {DATA_PLATFORM}, preserve quality flags and let the dietitian accept the complete reproducibility package before a separate restricted archive commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ad hoc analysis sessions make repeated data checks and reproducibility packaging labour-intensive.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned statistical scripts and dataset checks can implement an explicit analysis plan without a language model.
tasks.still_hard: Small samples, confounding, ancestry effects and uncertain biological interpretation remain research problems.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether an association supports any nutritional conclusion at all.

ambition.what: Provide a reproducibility package tying each reported estimate to the approved analysis and dataset snapshot.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated calculation and archive handling; more scrutiny of quality failures and limits of inference. Clinical decision rights do not expand.

reach.task: Run a validated study-data quality checklist
reach.learn: Pseudonymous identifiers, units, missingness and protocol deviation logs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a prespecified statistical analysis can be rerun deterministically; choosing methods and interpreting genetic associations remain expert work.

assumptions: Boundary is an existing approved research programme, including its dietitian's data collection and reporting. Laboratory work and participant enrolment/consent are established separate workflows; they are neither removed nor transferred by this design. Provisional focal baseline is 95; ethics review is 5 outside it.

s1 specifies variable names, units, exclusions, missingness rules, covariates, model formula, multiplicity correction and quality thresholds. Qualified statistical review is part of existing protocol preparation, retained at full effort.

s3 includes separate observation capture work in the study database; dietitian manually enters participant_code, timepoint, dietary_measure, unit and protocol_deviation. Laboratory produces pseudonymous genotype fields variant_id, call, quality_score and assay_version. Missing or unmatched data are quarantined, not fabricated.

s3's conduct description covers observation and draft dataset capture, not a new external send or official database release. Physical conduct and data capture both retain 100%; repository commitment is separately s7.

Native configured analysis is tested before scripts. Saving applies only to repeated manual execution and packaging that actually occur, not existing compute runtime. s5 evaluates exclusions and meaning with full time.

s2 approves the completed protocol before study conduct; amendments require reapproval. s6 checks final report claims, script version, dataset hash and permitted archive access before s7. Archive access or content changes invalidate a2.
unknowns: Whether this occupation actually conducts such research in the organisation
research_questions: Do independent reruns reproduce every reported estimate and preserve exclusion reasons?

incremental.description: Maintain validated analysis scripts and regression checks after tool updates
Maintain secure research pipeline access and execution environment

approvals.approved_version: s2 completed approved study protocol, recruitment scope and participant safeguards; amendments revoke approval
s6 accepted research package version with dataset hash, script version and archive access snapshot

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional: 15 saved drafting units divided by the 95-unit focal baseline gives 15.79 points minus three upkeep = 12.79; partial eligible drafting gives four. Archiving retains full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce calculations and rewriting around professional dietary decisions while retaining cooking tests, consultation and research judgement.
reach: Support dietetic technicians with validated recipe fields and reproducible data checks.
role.ambitious_version: A dietitian who can show the evidence behind a recipe, advice note, budget and research result.
